info.title: CarShowroom ERP API
info.description: Backend REST API for the multi-tenant Car Showroom ERP. Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens. Every endpoint (except register/login) requires the "Authorization: Bearer {token}" header and is additionally gated by a spatie/laravel-permission permission key.

post.description: Sets the bonus status to "approved" or "paid". When status is "paid", an expense ledger entry is recorded for the bonus amount.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of rent orders — advance bookings taken before a vehicle is actually handed over — optionally filtered by status or customer.

post.description: Creates an advance booking for a customer and vehicle ahead of the actual rental hand-over. Generates a unique order number and sets status to "pending".

get.description: Returns a paginated list of rentals — the actual vehicle rent-out / hand-over events — optionally filtered by status or vehicle.

post.summary: Rent out a vehicle (create rental / vehicle hand-over)
post.description: Records the actual hand-over of a vehicle to a customer, optionally linked to a prior rent order (advance booking). Computes total days and rent amount from the daily rate, marks the vehicle as "rented", advances the linked rent order to "active", and logs any advance payment to the ledger.

post.summary: Return a rented vehicle and settle the rental
post.description: Closes out an active rental when the vehicle is brought back. Records the odometer reading and fuel level at return, computes kilometers driven (odometer_in minus the rental's recorded odometer_out) and the number of late days (return_date past expected_return_date). Sums late, damage, cleaning, and fuel charges into extra_charges, then computes the final settlement amount as: rent_amount - advance_paid + extra_charges. Creates the RentalReturn record, marks the rental as 'completed', marks the vehicle 'available' again, and — if the final settlement amount is positive — logs it as income on the showroom ledger. The deposit_refunded amount is recorded for reference but is not netted into final_amount.

odometer_in.description: Odometer reading at return; used with the rental's odometer_out to compute km_driven

deposit_refunded.description: Amount of the security deposit refunded to the customer; recorded for reference only, not netted into final_amount

damage_notes.example: Scratch noted near rear left door, customer acknowledged.

photos[].description: Inspection photos taken at return (jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 5MB each).

extra_charges.description: Sum of late_charges + damage_charges + cleaning_charges + fuel_charges

is_listed.description: Whether the storefront is visible on the public marketplace

post.summary: Replace the public storefront cover/banner image

get.description: Returns a paginated list of salary records, optionally filtered by staff, month, year, or status.

post.description: Creates a salary record for a staff member for a given month/year, computing the net salary and payment status.

put.description: Updates a salary record, recomputing the net salary and payment status from the merged values.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of shifts.

post.summary: Assign a staff member to a shift

get.description: Returns a paginated list of staff salary advances, optionally filtered by staff or repayment status.

post.description: Records a salary advance given to a staff member. If "balance" is omitted it defaults to the full "amount" (nothing repaid yet); if "repayment_status" is omitted it defaults to "pending". Both can be set explicitly, e.g. to record an advance that already has a partial balance.

balance.description: Remaining unpaid balance; defaults to the full amount if omitted. Cannot exceed amount.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of staff attendance records, optionally filtered by staff, date range, or status.

post.description: Records a staff attendance entry for a given date, automatically computing working and overtime hours when both check-in and check-out are provided.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of staff members, optionally filtered by status, department, or search term.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches first name, last name, or employee code

post.description: Creates a new staff member and optionally provisions a linked user login with a role. The employee_code is auto-generated server-side (format "EMP-" followed by 8 random digits) and cannot be set via the request.

documents[].description: CNIC copy, contract, certificates etc. (jpg/jpeg/png/webp/pdf, max 5MB each)

create_login.description: If true, creates a linked User login using password and role

role.description: Required if create_login is true; must be an existing role name

get.description: Includes a "performance" object with overview KPIs: current shift, this-month attendance (present days / recorded days, on-time rate), leave balance, overtime hours, monthly salary, total vehicles handled (sales + assigned jobs + driven rentals), and a 6-month attendance-rate trend. Note: this does not include a customer/performance star rating, since the app has no reviews/ratings module to back that figure — add one first if that is needed.

put.description: Updates staff fields only. To replace the photo or add documents use the dedicated POST /staff/{staff}/photo and POST /staff/{staff}/documents endpoints — PHP does not parse multipart/form-data file uploads on PUT/PATCH requests.

post.description: Uploads a new profile picture, replacing and deleting the previous one from disk.

post.summary: Add documents to a staff member
post.description: Appends one or more documents (CNIC copy, contract, certificates etc.) to the staff record.

get.description: Returns platform-wide aggregate metrics (showroom counts by status, active users, total vehicles, active subscriptions, and paid subscription revenue). Requires the platform Super Admin role/permission (showrooms.view) — this permission is only ever granted to the "Super Admin" role at the platform level, not to any showroom role.
